name: CKEditor5 Markdown
description: Adds a CKEditor 5 toolbar button that converts pasted Markdown to HTML on demand.
project_description: CKEditor5 Markdown extends the core CKEditor 5 editor with a single toolbar button, "Paste Markdown". Clicking it opens a modal textarea; the editor pastes or types Markdown, clicks Insert, and the text is converted to HTML client-side with the bundled marked library (GitHub-Flavored Markdown enabled) and inserted at the cursor as CKEditor content. Unlike CKEditor's experimental auto-detect paste-markdown feature, conversion here is explicit and user-triggered, avoiding clipboard sniffing and interference with other paste plugins. The module is entirely front-end: it ships one CKEditor 5 JS plugin (markdownPaste.MarkdownPaste) plus CSS, and provides no PHP, routes, permissions, services, config schema, or database tables. Converted HTML is still constrained by the editor's active plugin schema and, on save, by the text format's normal filters.
